events.title: Devlog: Listening to Pilots — A Clearer Cockpit and a Fairer Fight
events.summary: Hi pilots! This update started with your comments, so I want to show you how they turned into changes."I never knew what the bars meant"This was the most common feedback. The old bottom panel had four bars and a speed number, and in a fast dogfight nobody looked at it. So I moved everything to where your eyes already are: heat is now the aiming ring, missiles sit around it, and hull and shield ride under your wing. The speed number is gone, because it never helped anyone win a fight.Fewer button

events.title: Big Update: New Combat HUD, Automatic Flares, Roll-Dodge & a Full Balance Pass
events.summary: Hi pilots! Thank you for every comment and every run. events.title: Demo Update: Flares, Combat Feedback, New UI & a Guided Tutorial
events.summary: Thank you for playing the Iron Void demo during Steam Next Fest! Your feedback shaped this update. Here is what's new:Flares and smarter missilesPress F (or D-pad Down) to drop flares. You carry 3 and they slowly recharge.Flares destroy the closest missiles locked on you and pull the rest away.A clear MISSILE INBOUND warning tells you when to use them.Enemy missiles now turn more realistically: out-fly them and they miss.Combat feedbackMulti-kill banners: DOUBLE, TRIPLE, QUAD and RAMPAGE.A combo

events.title: Devlog: Iron Void Doubles in Size – 120 Missions & 10 Bosses
events.summary: Hi pilots! Steam Next Fest has been amazing, and your feedback pushed us to do something big before launch: we doubled the campaign. Here is a look behind the scenes.120 missions in 10 actsThe campaign grows from 60 to 120 hand-built missions, now organized into ten acts. The story continues after Void Requiem: the silence was never the end – the signal is coming from deeper in the void.Act VI – Afterglow: bomber and turret sieges in the ashes of the last war.Act VII – Hollow Reach: spark swarms

events.title: Demo Update: Punchier Combat, New Camera & Clearer HUD
events.summary: Thank you again for all the feedback from Steam Next Fest! Here is what's new in the Iron Void demo:Combat feelMuzzle flashes on every gun – yours and your enemies' – so you always see who is firing.Missile smoke trails and launch puffs.Stronger screen shake when you fire, launch missiles, boost and when ships explode near you.Camera & settingsThe camera now sits further back so you can read the fight, with a wider default field of view.New Screen Shake and Camera Distance sliders in the setting

events.title: Demo Update: 12 Missions, First Boss & Evasive Roll
events.summary: Thank you for all the feedback during Steam Next Fest!
